label: MORNING BRIEF

stories.title: Hoima land up tenfold since 2022
stories.story: Knight Frank says land prices in the Hoima region have risen about tenfold since 2022, while some rents are still at pre-2022 levels. Its Hoima report launches on 26 Nov.
stories.you: Clients asking about the oil region? Pitch land with clean titles — that’s where prices moved.

stories.title: Njeru eviction put on hold
stories.story: Plans to evict about 600 fishermen and residents from Naminya landing site are suspended. UEGCL says it never authorised removing anyone.
stories.you: Disputes can turn either way. Keep contested plots off your list until the dispute is settled.

stories.title: NEMA clears crops off a wetland
stories.story: NEMA destroyed crops on about 200 hectares of a Masindi wetland and evicted six farmers. About 200 hectares more of wetland are next.
stories.you: Land near a swamp? Check it isn’t wetland before you sell — a buyer can lose it all.

stories.title: Ntungamo to number every plot
stories.story: Ntungamo plans to number plots and buildings and name roads in 2027/28, in a proposed Shs8.47 billion budget. Its detailed plan is only 4% done.
stories.you: Buyers trust an address. Put plot numbers and road names in your listings where they exist.

stories.title: 42 new mediators in the west
stories.story: 42 community mediators from Ibanda, Kazo and Mbarara were commissioned after four months of training, to settle disputes and ease court backlogs.
stories.you: A boundary row holding up a sale? Try mediation first — it’s faster than court.
